implemented: HostPump binds private monotonically allocated operation identities to concrete Runtime, RadioBoot, upper BootRuntime and aggregate receive transfers through canonical sd_controller::ControlPlane::begin and ControlledTransaction.

HostTransfer owns polling, IRQ notification collection, explicit cancellation, completion and drop cancellation. Completion releases the canonical controller lock before its correlated receipt is applied to the owned CPU consumer.

Physical host Completion, admission failure and abandoned transfer are distinct observations. Radio CMD53 physical write outcomes remain separate from source logical outcomes; register reads retain the actual pump scratch bytes. No synthetic firmware acceptance is generated.
NativeDriverSynchronization consumes initialized typed handles and directly calls canonical Power semaphore wait/signal ABI. It does not allocate semaphores or fabricate startup readiness.

ReceivePool owns externally supplied disjoint aggregate buffers. Non-Clone write and packet leases carry slot generations; a sealed ReceiveRead receipt binds publication to its physical aggregate generation. Last packet drop returns the aggregate to the fixed-capacity free queue.

Receive publication consumes the canonical validated ReceivePlan extents and Packet parser. Ethernet and management payloads are not copied; transient borrowed Frame values do not escape as ownership. PacketLease wire/payload borrows cannot outlive the owning lease.

DriverStopped is issued once after actual pump cancellation/quiescence, hardware cancellation reaping, Runtime terminal or idle phase, and adapter command and completion queue drainage. Root native task exit and kernel task deletion are separate obligations.
RadioSdioAttachment propagates canonical ClockProgress delay tokens. The native advance helper executes the actual Power task delay for the ten-tick output-enable retry.
actual_provider_dependencies: vendor_wireless_boot::RadioBoot and vendor_wireless_boot_runtime::BootRuntime, concrete request/receive/interrupt binding and typed abort_physical ingress; boot owner supplies actual initialized semaphore lifecycle
vendor_wireless_station_driver::receive::ReceivePlan,Packet and generation-safe canonical peer and reorder owners
canonical Power xm1_power_semaphore_wait,xm1_power_semaphore_signal,xm1_power_task_delay at the native physical RTOS boundary

unfinished_application_cpu.scope: Closed interrupt-cycle disable, 88-byte snapshot read, abnormal-status read, returned-credit application, receive-port aggregate processing and source enable/sleep ordering are not wired into HostPump. StationDriver supplies typed SnapshotRead and InterruptControl CPU; a root cycle still must consume them.

Correlated PendingCommands completions, management/association event routing, canonical PeerLease admission and device-PID TX-done routing remain unwired to the root service event loop. The packet pool makes retained ownership safe but does not perform these CPU actions.
Actual RandomPool entropy and native clock ingress are not integrated here. RadioTick is an explicit physical observation, not an implemented native clock bridge.

The root-owned native xm1_wireless_driver_task, permanent typed WirelessRuntime/provider context, event wake and exit publication are absent. Pump quiescence must not be presented as native task execution, shutdown acknowledgment or kernel task deletion.
Parent root module declarations, controller/task callsites, provider initialization, linker registration and complete source integration remain required.

tests.fixtures: Synthetic in-memory physical host, lock, cache and packet bytes. Loopback packet fixtures encode two four-byte records in a sixteen-byte aggregate; no proprietary payload is included.

verification: Source-only. No builds, tests, lint, formatters, SDK, native execution, camera, USB or radio operations. This increment does not claim complete wireless CPU closure or runtime acceptance.
